name: Copenhagen Plank

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: British Journal of Sports Medicine Copenhagen Adductor Protocol

steps: Lie on your side next to a sturdy low bench or chair, resting on your bottom forearm.
Place the knee and lower leg of your top leg on top of the bench.
Rest your bottom leg on the floor beneath the bench.
Press through your top knee and forearm to raise your hips off the floor into a side plank, lifting your bottom leg to hover just beneath the bench.
Hold this rigid line for the target duration, feeling your inner thigh work strongly, then lower with control.
coaching_cues: Beginners should start with the bench supporting from the knee (short lever) rather than the ankle.
Keep your shoulders and hips square without rotating toward the floor.
Breathe calmly and evenly throughout the hold.

sources.attribution: BJSM Copenhagen Adductor Exercise Clinical Trial
